The [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilan]] port [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Salline/Legends|Salline]] contained a '''government center''' at the end of the street [[Guildhead's Way/Legends|Guildhead's Way]]. The center was located near the city's docks and was fortified by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during its brief occupation of the city.<ref name="Handbook" />
